newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber mixed on technicals, weak play.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber mixed on technicals, weak play.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended the first trading week of 1997 mixed after participation from players remained weak while supply of raw materials improved from fine weather, traders said.
"Hopefully, we'll have a better week ahead," a trader told Reuters by telephone as he packed up for the day.
Traders said most players were either holidaying or unwilling to enter the market at the end of the week.
They said prices could dip further next week if fresh demand was not seen. Sunny skies since the start of January has created an ample supply of latex and other materials, said the traders.
